searchText: Current Görli gas limit is 8M. Given Görli is PoA, I suppose we could ask the operators to increase it to whatever level their hardware and connections can handle. Is there a rough upper limit on uncle rates Görli users are comfortable with? https://goerli.etherscan.io/block/4805487 😳What are they full of? Normally görli blocks are pretty empty. haven’t seen a specific contract that has gained traction and/or spam, but potentially more devs have joined the ecosystem in the past weeks 👀 Its the bzz token Sorry its not that pretty sure this is the cause: https://goerli.etherscan.io/address/0xf0277caffea72734853b834afc9892461ea18474 each swap on that contract takes 1.5 million gas so have a few swaps per block and they are pretty much full I believe the author is allowed to resurrect a withdrawn EIP. <jhancock76> Should be with a new EIP number though Only if a new author takes over I thought? Currently even the OG author. That's at least how I wrote it at the time. Could change though. The logic is that older numbers have discourse and narrative built around them already. All of those old associations are left behind with that EIP when it gets withdrawn. And anyone, even the author included will need to bootstrap new associations with a new number. This may be over focused on controversial EIPs. I'm okay with that rule, just not how I remember it is all. I could be mistaken though and if that is what is written I won't push on it. Its in the chart, but thats about it.
